title: Add Bonus
summary: Return a copy of scores in which name's list has points added at the end (a new one-item list if name isn't there). Don't modify scores, and share none of its lists: the caller may change the result later.
hints: Copying the map gives you a new map, but its values are still the same lists. That's a shallow copy.
Copy every list as well (a deep copy), then add points to name's copy.
If name isn't in the map yet, start it with an empty list.
